'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Gaza City]]
***The director of the [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] in [[Gaza City]] says that the medical complex is "completely cut off", with any "moving person targeted" by [[Israeli forces]]. [[Médecins Sans Frontières]] confirms reports that people are being shot at as they try to exit the hospital. Palestinian health minister [[Mai al-Kaila]] says that [[Israel]]i forces have also [[shell (projectile)|shelled]] the hospital with [[white phosphorus munitions]] which are banned under [[international law]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/11/israeli-forces-close-in-on-al-shifa-hospital-trapping-thousands (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/11/we-are-minutes-away-from-death-gazas-al-shifa-hospital-under-attack (Al Jazeera 2)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera 3)]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli]] tanks and [[sniper]]s fire at the [[Al-Quds Hospital]] in Gaza City from within twenty meters, where around 14,000 [[internally displaced person|displaced people]] are sheltering in a state of "extreme panic and fear", according to the [[Palestinian Red Crescent]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/growing-concerns-allies-israels-approach-fighting-hamas-civilian-104817510 (ABC News)]
**The [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs|UN Humanitarian Affairs Office]] reports that at least 45 [[Palestinians]] have been displaced in the [[West Bank]] following Israeli [[Israeli demolition of Palestinian property|punitive demolition]]s. [https://www.ochaopt.org/content/hostilities-gaza-strip-and-israel-flash-update-35 (OCHA)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Digital rights]] organization [[Access Now]] says that shutdowns affecting [[internet access]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] are providing "cover for human rights atrocities", which are being worsened by [[Israel]]'s control over [[internet]] access. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Norwegian Refugee Council]] condemns Israeli attacks on Gaza hospitals, calling for an urgent [[ceasefire]] and for the protection of medical staff, saying that "it is an affront to wage war around and on hospitals". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] says that the transfer of [[solid waste]] to [[landfill]]s has stopped across the Gaza Strip because of insecurity and a shortage of fuel. The [[World Health Organization]] reports that the spread of [[infectious disease]]s including [[diarrhea]] and [[chickenpox]] are increasing rapidly, with medical organizations warning of the risk of a possible [[cholera]] [[epidemic]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**At least 11,078 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza. The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs says that 168 Palestinians, including 46 children, have been killed by Israeli forces in the West Bank. Another eight people, including one child, were killed by [[Israeli settlers]] in [[East Jerusalem]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**An [[Amal Movement]] militant killed and two militants injured in a missile attack in [[Rab El Thalathine]], [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://en.royanews.tv/news/46367/2023-11-11 (RoyaNews)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***A [[Myanmar Air Force]] [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]] crashes  in [[Kayah State]] near [[Myanmar–Thailand border|the border]] with [[Thailand]]. The [[Karenni Nationalities Defence Force]] claims responsibility for shooting it down, however the [[Tatmadaw]] claims the crash occurred due to a technical problem. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-fighter-jet-crashes-rebels-claim-responsibility-2023-11-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches its first [[missile]] attacks against [[Kyiv]] in 52 days. Most of the [[ballistic missile]]s are intercepted by Ukrainian [[anti-aircraft warfare|air defences]]. No casualties are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-capital-kyiv-comes-under-air-attack-blasts-heard-2023-11-11/ (Reuters)]
**[[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
***Former [[NATO]] [[Secretary General of NATO|Secretary General]] [[Anders Fogh Rasmussen]] puts forward a proposal for Ukraine to join the [[military alliance]] but without the territories occupied by Russia. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/11/ex-nato-chief-proposes-ukraine-joins-without-russian-occupied-territories (The Guardian)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Shambat Bridge]], which connects [[Omdurman]] and [[Khartoum North]], is destroyed amid intense fighting in the capital [[Khartoum]]. Both sides blame each other for the destruction of the bridge. [https://sudantribune.com/article279244/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Pope]] [[Pope Francis|Francis]] removes [[Bishops in the Catholic Church|Bishop]] [[Joseph Strickland]] of the [[Diocese of Tyler]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], due to his criticism of the [[Catholic Church]]'s [[progressivism|progressive]] views under Francis. Strickland is temporarily replaced by Bishop [[Joe S. Vásquez]] of the [[Diocese of Austin]]. The decision comes after Strickland declined to resign when asked to do so. [https://apnews.com/article/pope-tyler-bishop-strickland-removed-0f9f0be7d5938b36d6e7ead8c33e5150 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Around 150 [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment factories]] in [[Ashulia]] and [[Gazipur]], [[Bangladesh]], close indefinitely after violent protests demanding higher [[minimum wage]]s result in [[Bangladesh Police|police]] filing charges against 11,000 workers and three more killed. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231111-150-bangladesh-garment-factories-shut-11-000-workers-charged (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and incidents'''
*[[2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions]]
**The [[Blue Lagoon (geothermal spa)|Blue Lagoon]] is closed by [[Iceland]]ic authorities as a volcanic eruption on the [[Southern Peninsula (Iceland)|Reykjanes Peninsula]] is expected in the "coming hours". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/iceland-volcano-earthquakes-flights-keflavik-b2445470.html (''The Independent'')]
**The town of [[Grindavík]] is [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] due to potential [[magma]] intrusion beneath the town. [https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/news/2023/11/11/grindavik_evacuated_due_to_possible_magma_intrusion/ (Iceland Monitor)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Mexico|Mexican]] officials impose severe, months long cuts to [[Mexico City]]’s water supply, acting just a month after initial restrictions were ordered as [[drought]] dries the city's [[reservoirs]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-city-water-restrictions-drought-f7c0ccd809d35894890aaf509d1d60c8 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**The Arab-Islamic emergency summit in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], releases a statement calling for an end to the siege of [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], demanding that aid be allowed to enter Gaza, and calling for a cessation of [[arms exports]] to [[Israel]]. The statement also says that Israel's war should not be described as "self-defence" and condemned Israeli aggression in Gaza and the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**Emir of [[Qatar]] Sheikh [[Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani]] condemns the international community for remaining silent on the suffering of Palestinian civilians while allowing Israel to violate [[international law]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Egypt]]ian President [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] says that the "policies of [[collective punishment]]" in Gaza are unacceptable and "cannot be justified by self-defence or any other claims". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Philippe Lazzarini]], the head of the [[UNRWA]], calls on Arab countries to take stronger action to protect civilians in Gaza and to exercise pressure to increase the flow of [[humanitarian aid]] into Gaza, including through the opening of additional [[border crossing]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals (Al Jazeera)]
